summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. filed Form 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of a 119-room Hilton Garden Inn in Jacksonville, FL for $11.3M in cash, subject to customary adjustments. Net proceeds totaled ~$11.0M after selling expenses; ~$9.5M was paid to the mortgage lender on the property's multi-hotel loan. The buyer was Maco Properties, L.L.C. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The filing included unaudited pro forma financials and reflects a straightforward asset disposition. What to watch: the remaining seven cross-collateralized hotels and potential deleveraging from the proceeds.
